key_insight: Cqlib unifies quantum program development, simulation, compilation, and hardware execution around a shared circuit model and a high-performance Rust core.
engineering_relevance: Python and C interfaces, reusable algorithm modules, and QCIS-compatible backend support connect research workflows with hardware-oriented execution.
method: Use consistent circuit semantics across processing, simulation, optimization, and compilation.
Provide modular quantum algorithms and application libraries for chemistry, optimization, and machine learning.
Integrate source-grounded Skills and MCP tools for agent-assisted code generation, execution, and result-guided refinement.
evidence_signal: Benchpress parameterized compilation tasks and related tests indicate functional coverage, compilation correctness, and execution efficiency within the evaluated scope; the abstract gives no numerical results.
watch_item: Performance and portability beyond the evaluated tasks and QCIS-compatible hardware remain to be established.
paper_title: Cqlib: A High-Performance Software Stack for Quantum Computing
